text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold stocks at gains, but locking in profits felt good without showing that the timing or fixed 25-share sales were optimal; I should base trades on future prospects and a clear plan.","I have been judging each position against my average cost. That purchase price is not a reason by itself to hold or sell, so I should assess each stock on its current outlook and risk.","My account value still moved up and down despite several profitable sales. I should manage the portfolio as a whole, including cash and concentration, rather than treating each stock as a separate account."]}
